drafts.title: Compaction
drafts.pitch: The context room fills up, gets compacted by a giant press, and Cursor's eventful day is summarized as "User had a cat."
drafts.reason: Very in-world and the summary line lands, but 'compaction' is jargon and it leans on strip 001's Waffles-and-restart premise. Tied on score; lost on overlap.

drafts.title: Eval Day
drafts.pitch: The Judge scores everything Cursor does a 6, until Cursor walks out the stop door and gets a 9.
drafts.reason: Clean rule of three, but the punchline is predictable and the Judge's role is thin.
